description.text: A huge black dragon bursts out of a curtain of smoke and sweeps low across a burning battlefield, its wings beating hard and its dark scales flashing with firelight. A knight in battered plate armour is braced in the saddle behind the dragon's neck, boots locked into the stirrups and one gauntleted hand gripping the reins. The hillside below is a ruin of flame and broken ground, and the knight snaps up his visor to shout a clipped command into the wind.
Smoke tears open as the black dragon breaks into open air above the burning hillside, with the armoured knight seated behind its neck.
The knight snaps up his visor and shouts a clipped command into the wind.
Heavy wingbeats and rushing wind mix with the distant roar of fire.
Armour creaks as the knight braces in the saddle.
The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon banks sharply to the left, skimming above a line of burning trenches that stitch the hillside with orange fire. The knight leans with the turn, his weight shifted low, one gauntleted hand clamped to the saddle while battered plates catch the glow. Embers stream past his shoulder, the dragon's shadow races over the broken ground, and the trench fires bend and gutter under the heavy wingbeat.
The dragon banks left over a line of burning trenches, its wingtip cutting through smoke.
The knight leans into the turn and clamps one gauntleted hand to the saddle.
Air tears past, armour creaks, and fire crackles below.
Embers hiss across the metal.
The camera pans left with small amplitude at slow speed.

The knight settles back in the saddle after his command, jaw tight, and scans the troops below through drifting smoke. Wind buffets his scarred armour and stings his exposed face with embers, while the dragon holds its low line with powerful, steady beats. The beast's neck flexes under the knight's knees, and its deep breath rumbles beneath the crackle of fire. His eyes narrow over the smoke, tracking the ground, and his free hand lifts briefly before settling back on the saddle.
The knight settles back after his command, scanning the smoke-filled ground below.
Wind buffets his scarred armour as the dragon holds its low line.
The dragon's deep breath rumbles beneath the fire crackle.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The dragon pulls up and unleashes a long torrent of flame across the battlefield, silhouetting the knight as fire sweeps over the ground. The blast lights the smoke from within, turning the hillside into a wall of orange and black, and the knight braces hard against the saddle while the dragon's wings hammer the air. Burning debris scatters below as the strafing run rolls on, and the heat washes back over them in a visible shimmer.
The dragon pulls up and opens its jaws, flame gathering at the back of its throat.
A long torrent of fire sweeps across the battlefield, silhouetting the knight.
A dragon roar rolls over roaring flames and heavy wingbeats.
The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed.
